The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Identifies this as the Android Gradle Plugin 9 built-in Kotlin migration rather than a generic Gradle error
- Checks android/gradle.properties and sets android.newDsl=false and android.builtInKotlin=false before any other change
- Replaces the kotlin-android plugin and kotlinOptions block with a kotlin { compilerOptions { } } block, not just deleting the plugin
- Does not enable android.builtInKotlin=true until every Flutter plugin dependency is confirmed migrated

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
